title: From Season 5 (Final Season): Release Date Status, Where to Watch in India and What We Know
seoTitle: When Is From Last Season Coming? Season 5 Release Status
seoDescription: From Season 5 is the final season, but MGM+ has not announced a release date yet. It is targeted for 2027; in India the show streams on Amazon Prime Video.
excerpt: What MGM+ has actually confirmed about the last season of From, how filming went in Halifax, where Indian viewers can catch up on Prime Video and Netflix, and a spoiler-marked recap of the Season 4 finale.
